# Environment diagnostics (reference only)

Use only when the operator explicitly asks for environment diagnosis. Bounded
read-only checks may inspect port listeners, process metadata, lockfiles, and
installed dependency versions.

This reference grants no authority to kill a process, install or upgrade a
package, restart a service, mutate configuration, or repair the environment.
Present evidence and request the applicable operator gate before any such
action. It is not activated implicitly by words such as `port` or `install`.
